title: boreal reference URI scheme with fail-soft registry resolution
description: WHY: every cross-project feature (portfolio containers, inbox routing provenance, board links) needs one canonical address form. WHAT: (1) in @boreal/core, a parse-format-validate module for boreal://<project-id>/<record-id> URIs - strict character set aligned with normalizeMachineString, typed result distinguishing record kinds by id prefix (bw_work_, bw_evidence_, etc.); (2) acceptance anywhere a SourceRef uri is accepted (packages/core/src/records.ts lines 39-43 - validation must not reject the new scheme); (3) a resolution API taking the registry plus a URI and returning a typed result: resolved (record snapshot read from the target workspace store read-only), unresolved-unlinked, unresolved-missing-project, unresolved-missing-record - callers branch on the type, nothing throws for the unresolved cases; (4) resolution respects lifecycle states from sprint G1 (archived projects resolve as unresolved-unlinked with last-known data when a rollup exists). Unit tests for every result type including a deleted project directory.
acceptanceCriteria: URI parse-format round-trips and rejects unsafe input, covered by tests
Resolution returns typed unresolved results for unlinked, missing-project, and missing-record cases without throwing
SourceRef accepts boreal URIs end to end through work create --source
closedReason: Implemented and verified boreal reference URI scheme
